Intel: Kotlin package header emitted as Module and class name resolved via type_identifier fallback (#111, #112)

```swift title="Swift"
import TreeSitterLanguagePack

let configObj = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.processConfigFromJson("{\"language\":\"kotlin\"}")
let result = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.process(source: "package foo.bar\n\nclass Widget {\n    fun greet(): String = \"hi\"\n}\n", config: configObj)
debugPrint(result.language())
debugPrint(result.structure())
debugPrint(result.structure()[0].kind())
debugPrint(result.metrics().errorCount())
```
